🇲🇽🏥 <u>MEXICO REBUILDS PUBLIC HEALTH: 32 NEW HOSPITALS</u>

Mexico's public health system is being rebuilt after decades of neglect: 32 new hospitals inaugurated in the last two years, with 9,000 more beds on the way. The comparison is brutal — in 36 neoliberal years the IMSS added just 4,000 beds; in the decades before, more than 27,000. Sheinbaum: "El periodo neoliberal fue muy dañino, en particular para la salud pública."

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO, BELIZE AND GUATEMALA UNITE FOR THE GRAN SELVA MAYA</u>

One year after the Calakmul Declaration, the three countries presented a Regional Action Plan for the Gran Selva Maya Biocultural Corridor — 5.7 million hectares of jungle, home to more than 2 million people, one of Mesoamerica's last great forests. Regional cooperation with no Washington at the table: this is what integration built from the south looks like.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>SUPREME COURT SEEKS 1.8BN-PESO SLUSH FUND</u>

Mexico's Supreme Court — the same one crying austerity after the judicial reform — wants to create a 1.8-billion-peso reserve fund, reviving the old fideicomiso vices, Contralínea reports. Budget talks for 2027 also exposed that taxpayers still foot the justices' private medical insurance: 135 million pesos this year, 146 million requested for next, at the initiative of Yasmín Esquivel and five other ministers. Austerity was always for everyone else.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>EX-SINALOA SECURITY CHIEF VANISHES FROM US PRISONS</u>

Retired general Gerardo Mérida Sánchez — Sinaloa's public security chief until 2024 — has disappeared from the US Bureau of Prisons registry. He surrendered to US authorities in Arizona on May 11, facing New York charges of drug-import conspiracy and machine-gun possession. The BOP now lists him as out of custody since August 11, and no one will say where he is. When Washington takes custody of Mexican officials, accountability vanishes with them.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>MEXICO'S ELECTORAL TRIBUNAL LOSES ITS PRESIDENT</u>

Mónica Soto Fregoso resigned as magistrate of the TEPJF, effective August 31 — her term ran until 2028. She gave no reasons, only that she decided to "concluir un ciclo" inside the institution. Soto took over the tribunal in December 2023 after three magistrates forced out Reyes Rodríguez Mondragón. The Senate now picks her replacement, and the old judiciary's internal wars go on.

🇲🇽📊 <u>WORLD CUP NO MIRACLE: CONSUMPTION FLATLINED IN JULY, SAYS INEGI</u>

Private consumption grew just 0.2% in June and stalled in July, INEGI's early IOCP indicator estimates — after a marginal 0.1% in May (El Economista). Hosting the World Cup was no magic wand for the domestic market. The data points to where the next battle is.

🇲🇽💧 <u>SHEINBAUM AND DELFINA FLOOD-PROOF THE EAST OF EDOMEX</u>

Plan Oriente is rehabilitating the Churubusco-Xochiaca tunnel: 16,000 liters per second of drainage capacity shielding over a million residents of Nezahualcóyotl, Chimalhuacán and La Paz. Generations of floods in the Valley of Mexico's east, answered with hydraulic works at scale — not promises.

🇲🇽🌲 <u>PROFEPA SEIZES 3,008 M³ OF ILLEGAL TIMBER, SHUTTERS 27 SITES</u>

Mexico's environmental prosecutor ran its third simultaneous forest crackdown across 26 states: 3,008 cubic meters of timber seized and 27 sites closed — including illegal logging inside the Monarch Butterfly Biosphere Reserve in Michoacán, where pine, oak and white cedar were felled. 55 inspections, 28 transport checkpoints, 82 pieces of sawmill machinery confiscated. Enforcement with teeth.

🇲🇽🕊️ <u>"WE'RE NOT LEAVING LA MONTAÑA": THE STATE STAYS IN GUERRERO</u>

Interior Secretary Rosa Icela Rodríguez presented the Master Plan for Montaña Alta y Baja: since May 13, nineteen federal agencies on the ground in 19 communities across Atlixtac, Chilapa, Olinalá and Zapotitlán Tablas — security plus health, education, housing and field support across 13 axes. "No nos vamos a salir de la región." Not an operation, a presence.

🇲🇽🏺 <u>BOSTON HANDS BACK 1,132 PRE-HISPANIC PIECES TO MEXICO</u>

Mexico recovered 1,132 archaeological pieces voluntarily restituted at its consulate in Boston: 1,053 ceramic sherds, 36 shark teeth, obsidian and flint blades, figurines from the southeast. Coordinated by SRE, Culture and INAH. Under the 4T, more than 17,000 looted artifacts have been brought home — quiet diplomacy, piece by piece.
